description: This file defines the LocationAttribute class, which represents a user-defined attribute associated with a Location in the OpenMRS system. The class manages an attribute ID and links to a Location object, extending BaseAttribute and implementing Attribute interfaces.

classes.name: LocationAttribute
classes.description: Represents a user-defined attribute of a Location, with methods to get and set attribute ID and associated Location object.

methods.name: getLocationAttributeId
methods.description: Returns the ID of this LocationAttribute.

methods.name: setLocationAttributeId
methods.description: Sets the ID of this LocationAttribute.

methods.name: getLocation
methods.description: Returns the Location object associated with this attribute.

methods.name: setLocation
methods.description: Associates a Location object with this attribute.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of this LocationAttribute, overriding the method from OpenmrsObject.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of this LocationAttribute, overriding the method from OpenmrsObject.
